'''Renlo Hens''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarian]] [[Miner/Legends|miner]] that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Renlo Hens appeared as a non-player character in the video game [[Star Wars Galaxies]], a massive multiplayer online-role playing game developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
